name: Exhaust Systems
description: Vents, ducts, fan-driven pumps and filter stacks that clean smog before it leaves.

pages.title: Exhaust Systems
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Vents** pull smog into **Ducts**, a **Pump** pushes it up and out
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A pump runs from an **Encased Fan** under it
- **Filter Frames** on the way out catch every kind of smog and let out harmless exhaust, with nothing to refill
- Filtered exhaust must reach the open sky

Smoke left alone rises into the cloud over your base. An exhaust system catches it at the source, cleans it and lets it out high up.\
\
The parts are Advanced Chimneys chimneys, vents, ducts and pumps, plus Filter Frames.

pages.title: Chimney
pages.text: Stone, brick, metal and glass chimneys carry smoke up. One on top of a furnace or burner takes its smoke straight in. Smoke that leaves the top unfiltered still joins the cloud.

pages.title: Vent
pages.text: The intake inside the room. It pulls in smog up to 4 blocks away. Join it to a pump with ducts. A stone version works the same.

pages.title: Duct
pages.text: Carries smog from vents and machines to a pump, up to 256 blocks. A duct joins a vent beside or above it, not below. A duct touching a machine takes its smoke straight in.

pages.title: Pump
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Runs while an [#](2E5AAC)[Encased Fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() right under it turns at 16 RPM or more, blowing up or down. The fan's [#](2E5AAC)[stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() is what the pump costs. It pushes smog upward only, into the chimney or frames above it.

pages.title: Filter Frame
pages.text: Stack frames on the pump's outlet. Every frame catches all three kinds of smog (carbon, sulfur and dust) and needs nothing put in it. An iron frame filters 2 units a second, gold 4, diamond 8. Right-click a frame to see its rate.

pages.title: Respirator filters
pages.text:
Craft a **Respirator** with one of these to pick what it stops:
- Leaves: carbon, 8 units each
- Wool: sulfur, 8
- Paper: dust, 8
- Filter Cartridge: carbon, 32
- Brass Filter Cartridge: carbon and sulfur, 64
- Precision Filter Cartridge: all three, 128

A clogged cartridge comes clean with a [#](2E5AAC)[Fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() blowing through water, sometimes with Soot. Soot burns as fuel, makes black dye, or [#](7A3C9A)[compacts](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() to Graphite and a Block of Soot.

pages.title: Busy stacks
pages.text:
A frame never fills up or runs out. When smog arrives faster than a stack filters, the rest waits below until it can pass; nothing slips through unfiltered.\
\
To filter faster, stack more frames or use gold or diamond ones. Two iron frames filter as much as one gold.

A pump moves about 1.5 units a second whatever its speed, so one iron frame keeps up with it. Gold and diamond pay off in a sealed room's roof, where pressure pushes harder (see [#](2E5AAC)[Pressure and Sealed Casings](entry://survival/smog_pressure)[#]()).

pages.title: Mixed smog
pages.text: Every frame catches carbon, sulfur and dust alike, so one stack handles mixed smog.

pages.title: Filtered exhaust
pages.text: What a filter lets out is **filtered exhaust**: a pale haze, harmless and not pollution. It rises, slips up through chimneys and frames, and drifts along ceilings. Under the open sky it thins away within a couple of seconds.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** exhaust is not air. A filter whose top is closed takes nothing. Exhaust trapped indoors stays, fills the room, and smog can't move into it. Give every filter a way up to the sky.

pages.title: Respirator
pages.text: Wear it on your head: it keeps smog out of your lungs and wears down as it works. Craft it with filter material to choose what it stops. Gold and diamond ones last longer. Create Backtanks and the Create Big Cannons gas mask protect too.

pages.title: Vacuum Tube
pages.text: Hold use to suck up the gas in front of you into Vacuum Bags in your inventory. Without a bag it blows the gas behind you.

pages.title: In depth
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A hopper on a pump also pulls smog from 8 blocks around and 3 up. Encased Fans push smog blocks along their air stream.\
\
Old Air Scrubbers and Flues no longer clean or vent anything; they are decoration.
